purpose: Resolves 5 Biome/format/convention findings from issue #223 in the frontend hooks: fixes format drift in useOfflineCheckin.ts, rewrites a stale Phase 2 header in usePWAInstall.ts, aligns the useAuth.ts re-export to the @/ alias, types the VAPID response in usePushNotifications.ts, and documents the hooks naming convention in AGENTS.md.
riskRationale: All changes are cosmetic or type-safety improvements with no runtime behavior change; however the PR description inaccurately claims PWAInstallBanner.tsx was reworded when the commit does not touch it, leaving the misleading Phase 2 marker the PR set out to remove still present in that in-use file.

text: This is a small, well-scoped autofix PR that is largely correct: the Biome format drift in useOfflineCheckin.ts, the stale Phase 2 marker in usePWAInstall.ts, the alias-convention alignment in useAuth.ts, the untyped VAPID response, and the AGENTS.md naming documentation all match their stated findings and compile cleanly. The one notable problem is a plan/description mismatch: the PR description claims frontend/components/shared/PWAInstallBanner.tsx was reworded, but commit c50a42b does not touch that file, so its misleading 'Phase 2: Outside MVP...' header remains — leaving exactly the hazard the usePWAInstall.ts fix was meant to eliminate. Independent format/lint re-verification was not possible (node_modules not installed in this checkout), so those claims rest on the author's report.

reasoning: The committed changes are sound, but the PR description overstates the scope: PWAInstallBanner.tsx was claimed to be reworded and was not, leaving the stale Phase 2 marker in a file that consumes usePWAInstall and could mislead future auto-fixes into deleting an in-use banner. Apply the one-line comment fix to PWAInstallBanner.tsx (or amend the description) before merging.

message: Typing the VAPID endpoint with api.get<{ publicKey?: string }> is a precise, minimal fix: it gives response.publicKey compile-time safety while the existing runtime typeof guard remains as defense-in-depth. No Zod schema is warranted for a single optional field, and the author verified the check against lib/shared/schemas/.

Rewording the stale 'Phase 2: Outside MVP Phase 1 scope' header to 'PWA install prompt support (in use).' is the right call — the hook is fully implemented and consumed by PWAInstallBanner, and the old marker could have tricked an auto-fix into deleting a live feature.

Switching the re-export from '../lib/auth-context' to '@/lib/auth-context' aligns with the @/* convention used across hooks/ and is relocation-safe; tsc confirms it resolves to lib/auth-context.tsx via the @/* → ./* tsconfig path mapping.

Documenting the hooks naming convention (camelCase useFoo.ts, kebab-case exception only for generated shadcn files) is the correct, low-risk resolution for the file-naming finding — renaming ~50 importers for useAuth would have been regression-prone churn.

The PR description and 'Files Changed' list state that PWAInstallBanner.tsx's stale header was reworded, but commit c50a42b does not modify this file — the '// Phase 2: Outside MVP Phase 1 scope. Keep for Phase 2 implementation.' header is still present at lines 1-2 (verified). This matters because the whole point of the usePWAInstall.ts comment fix was to remove the Phase 2 marker from in-use files so a future audit/auto-fix (which explicitly searches for that marker) does not delete live code. PWAInstallBanner.tsx consumes usePWAInstall and is rendered in the app, so the exact hazard the PR aimed to prevent remains, and the description misrepresents the change set.
suggestion: Reword the header in PWAInstallBanner.tsx to match usePWAInstall.ts, or if intentionally out of scope, correct the PR description to remove this file from 'Files Changed'.

message: The re-wrap of the queueCheckin call and removal of the blank line after the mutationFn arrow are stated as the result of running biome format --write, which is the right approach for format drift. However, the 'biome format hooks/ exit 0' claim could not be independently confirmed because node_modules is not installed in this checkout — if CI enforces a format gate, the reviewer should confirm the hooks/ tree is actually format-clean before trusting the claim.
suggestion: Confirm biome format hooks/ (and ideally pnpm lint and pnpm typecheck) pass on a machine with dependencies installed, or via CI, since the local verification in this environment is not reproducible.
